scientific_integrity: The infinite result is proved by exhaustive central-label decomposition. All-weight counts are distinguished from the previously established minimum Italian domination number; no independent assessment is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only ordinary Italian domination on clique bouquets with one hub, at least two blades, and blade sizes at least two; no general block graph characterization. Finite tests are not an infinite proof. Prior-literature searches may miss unindexed exact formulas.
title: Italian domination polynomial of heterogeneous clique bouquets
